waypoints.name: Blue Lake Trailhead
waypoints.note: Signed trailhead on SR-20 ~1 mi west of Washington Pass; follow Blue Lake Trail then the climber's path up to the Concord-Lexington gully.
waypoints.directions: Drive SR-20 (the North Cascades Highway) to the signed Blue Lake Trailhead on the south side of the highway, about 1 mile west of Washington Pass and roughly 30 miles west of Winthrop, at about 5,400 ft. A Northwest Forest Pass or the day-use fee is required, and the small lot fills early. SR-20 over the pass is closed in winter.

waypoints.name: Concord Tower Summit
waypoints.note: Shared summit for all Concord Tower routes.
waypoints.directions: Hike the Blue Lake Trail about 1.5 miles until it opens out, then take the climbers' path on the left at a large cairn. Work up and left into the Concord-Lexington gully, not the Liberty Bell-Concord one, using the path along its left side to the Concord-Lexington notch. From the notch, traverse the gravelly ledges on Concord's side and climb the three pitches of the South Face, over the Shark Fin, to the summit.
